BiblicalUsage: mashqôwph is a lintel, the upper door post, and it belongs to the passover night. In Exodus 12:7 the blood is struck on the two side posts and on the upper door post, and in Exodus 12:22 the lintel and the two side posts are struck with the blood in the basin. In Exodus 12:23 the LORD, seeing the blood upon the lintel, passes over the door and will not let the destroyer come in. The word is the beam the blood marks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mashqôwph shows me that the blood on the doorpost is the sign that saves. I hold that Christ is my lintel and my passover.
